prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH season_points AS (
  SELECT year, constructor_id, SUM(points) as total_points 
  FROM races r
  JOIN constructor_results cr ON r.race_id = cr.race_id
  WHERE r.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY year, constructor_id
),
point_scoring_seasons AS (
  SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
  FROM season_points
  WHERE total_points > 0
  GROUP BY year
),
worst_constructors AS (
  SELECT sp.year, sp.constructor_id, sp.total_points, pss.min_points
  FROM season_points sp
  JOIN point_scoring_seasons pss ON sp.year = pss.year AND sp.total_points = pss.min_points
)
SELECT c.name, c.constructor_id, COUNT(*) as worst_seasons_count
FROM worst_constructors wc
JOIN constructors c ON wc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.name, c.constructor_id
ORDER BY worst_seasons_count DESC, c.name

SQL:
WITH constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(cr.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN constructor_results cr ON r.race_id = cr.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id, c.name
),
point_scoring_constructors AS (
    SELECT constructor_id, name, total_points, year
    FROM constructor_points
    WHERE total_points > 0
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM point_scoring_constructors
    GROUP BY year
),
worst_constructors AS (
    SELECT psc.constructor_id, psc.name, psc.year, psc.total_points
    FROM point_scoring_constructors psc
    JOIN min_points_per_year mpp ON psc.year = mpp.year AND psc.total_points = mpp.min_points
)
SELECT constructor_id, name, COUNT(*) as worst_seasons
FROM worst_constructors
GROUP BY constructor_id, name
ORDER BY worst_seasons DESC, name
LIMIT 5

[C]
SQL:
WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        ra.year,
        c.constructor_id,
        c.constructor_ref,
        SUM(r.points) as constructor_points
    FROM races ra
    JOIN results r ON ra.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE ra.year >= 2001
      AND r.points > 0
    GROUP BY ra.year, c.constructor_id, c.constructor_ref
),
season_min AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(constructor_points) as min_p
    FROM season_points
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_min_seasons AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.constructor_id,
        sp.constructor_ref,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sm.year = sp.year AND sp.constructor_points = sm.min_p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as min_season_count
    FROM season_points sp
    JOIN season_min sm ON sp.year = sm.year
    GROUP BY sp.constructor_id, sp.constructor_ref
)
SELECT constructor_ref, CAST(min_season_count AS BIGINT) as min_season_count
FROM constructor_min_seasons
ORDER BY min_season_count DESC, constructor_ref
LIMIT 5

        r.year,
        cr.constructor_id,
        SUM(cr.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN constructor_results cr ON r.race_id = cr.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
        AND cr.points > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, cr.constructor_id
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
bottom_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.year,
        cp.constructor_id,
        cp.total_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN min_points_per_year mpy ON cp.year = mpy.year AND cp.total_points = mpy.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        constructor_id,
        COUNT(*) as seasons_at_bottom
    FROM bottom_constructors
    GROUP BY constructor_id
)
SELECT 
    c.name as constructor_name,
    cc.seasons_at_bottom
FROM constructor_counts cc
JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cc.seasons_at_bottom DESC, cc.constructor_id
LIMIT 5
